title: Is the upper bound of a closed knot's minimum ropelength linear to its crossing number
exact_target: Can every nontrivial knot be tied with unit-radius rope whose length is bounded by a universal constant times its crossing number?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 7200083 (AMR-071-0083). CC BY 4.0.
Yuanan Diao, Claus Ernst, Attila Por and Uta Ziegler, The Ropelengths of Knots Are Almost Linear in Terms of Their Crossing Numbers (2009), v1; arXiv:0912.3282.
